## PR Description

Fixes #2226

## Delivered

- **Streak cap default OFF (AC1/AC6)**: `InboxWakePolicy.defaultMaxInboxWakeStreak` is now 0 — the raw consecutive-wake counter is legacy. `messaging.wakeChatterCap: 10` re-enables the pre-#2226 behavior verbatim (receipts keep `wake_refused`). A 12-wake productive money-project chain with defaults runs uninterrupted (CLI-level REG test pins it).
- **Smart loop detection (AC2/AC3)**: `ChainLoopGuard` (`lib/src/messaging/chain_loop_guard.dart`) — per-counterparty pair windows, masked-text (ids/numbers → `#`) shingle-overlap similarity fused with a FRESH-STATE signal (new ids/commits/numbers each round). Loop verdict only when `stuckRounds` consecutive exchanges are both ≥ similarityThreshold AND carry no fresh state: templated-but-productive updates never pause (property-style test over 8-12 rounds), identical no-state ping-pong does (TDD).
- **Chain budget (AC4)**: `messaging.chainBudgetTokens` (default 400000) bounds autonomous agent↔agent spend; the CLI books chatter-lane wake-run usage at turn end (`onTurnEnd` → `recordSpend`). Exhaustion pauses like a loop verdict; `/chain continue` (and any delivered user input) resets the budget once per user ack. Spend + windows persist at `<messagesRoot>/_chain/state.json` via `ChainStateStore` — a restart never grants a fresh budget mid-chain (snapshot round-trip UT).
- **Never silent (AC5)**: every pause (loop | budget | legacy cap) renders the digest card (evidence, queued-mail count, both choices) on BOTH hosts — CLI bordered card, app `AppLog` digest lines (pending `mail:N` markers stay visible). `/chain continue` resumes; `/chain stop` drops only agent-kind mail with a `chain_stopped` tombstone receipt — user-kind mail is re-queued under a fresh id (the file layer dedupes re-sends against the consumed `read/` record — found by test) and always wakes.
- **Receipts (AC8)**: `chain_paused` events carry `reason: loop|budget` + evidence; legacy cap keeps `wake_refused` (UT + CLI REG).
- **Exemptions preserved (AC7)**: scheduled self-reminders stay exempt from every bound; timer semantics untouched; the rapid-self busy-spin guard stays armed whenever the legacy cap is on (with the cap off, the budget bounds spins instead — documented).
- **Config surface**: `messaging:` section (strict parse, both hosts read it — the app honors it through `AppFahSections`/`loadAppFahConfig`, same parsers, AC7 warn-and-default); parity registry classifies it as file-only with a WHY; completeness gate green.
- **Wake-gating only (AC9)**: delivery semantics, dedup, ordering untouched — a pause never consumes mail (REG tests assert pending stays pending across repeated ticks).
- Gates: standalone-SDK dart analyze clean on every touched file; dart format applied; targeted tests only — 221 core tests green (messaging 34 incl. 10 CLI wake REGs, parity completeness 14, attach 3); flutter analyze clean; app gh-1180 suite (4 tests incl. refusal receipts) green on the pinned 3.50.0 SDK; `agent_cli.dart` split (`agent_cli_chain_gate.dart` part) to stay under the 2800-line gate (2789).

## Remaining (honest scope vs the GOAL tiers)

- **App-side budget metering**: the Flutter host has no per-turn usage hook today, so its chain guard enforces loop verdicts but never accumulates spend — budget pauses on the app need the usage event surfaced first (CLI is the autonomous-chain workhorse; the guard-level UT covers the semantics).
- **App stop button**: the app offers resume-by-any-user-input (the GOAL's own no-deadlock advisory path) + the digest trail; a dedicated stop/continue affordance in the agents UI is not built (CLI has the full `/chain` surface).
- **Embedding-provider similarity**: implemented as the GOAL's documented fallback only (local shingle overlap, masked text) — there is no text-embedding provider in the repo to hook; adding one contradicts the issue's own 'no model calls in the wake path' non-goal.
- **Restart-persisted pause latching**: spend and stuck windows persist; the announce-once episode latch intentionally re-arms after restart so a still-held gate re-announces once (never silent).
- No prompt regeneration: the digest is user-facing UI chrome (same class as the existing `[mail] wake refused` line and btw panels); no agent-facing prompt text changed.

# pr-2380: feat(2226): smart loop detection + chain budget replace the wake streak cap (default OFF)

## Description

Fixes #2226

## Delivered

- **Streak cap default OFF (AC1/AC6)**: `InboxWakePolicy.defaultMaxInboxWakeStreak` is now 0 — the raw consecutive-wake counter is legacy. `messaging.wakeChatterCap: 10` re-enables the pre-#2226 behavior verbatim (receipts keep `wake_refused`). A 12-wake productive money-project chain with defaults runs uninterrupted (CLI-level REG test pins it).
- **Smart loop detection (AC2/AC3)**: `ChainLoopGuard` (`lib/src/messaging/chain_loop_guard.dart`) — per-counterparty pair windows, masked-text (ids/numbers → `#`) shingle-overlap similarity fused with a FRESH-STATE signal (new ids/commits/numbers each round). Loop verdict only when `stuckRounds` consecutive exchanges are both ≥ similarityThreshold AND carry no fresh state: templated-but-productive updates never pause (property-style test over 8-12 rounds), identical no-state ping-pong does (TDD).
- **Chain budget (AC4)**: `messaging.chainBudgetTokens` (default 400000) bounds autonomous agent↔agent spend; the CLI books chatter-lane wake-run usage at turn end (`onTurnEnd` → `recordSpend`). Exhaustion pauses like a loop verdict; `/chain continue` (and any delivered user input) resets the budget once per user ack. Spend + windows persist at `<messagesRoot>/_chain/state.json` via `ChainStateStore` — a restart never grants a fresh budget mid-chain (snapshot round-trip UT).
- **Never silent (AC5)**: every pause (loop | budget | legacy cap) renders the digest card (evidence, queued-mail count, both choices) on BOTH hosts — CLI bordered card, app `AppLog` digest lines (pending `mail:N` markers stay visible). `/chain continue` resumes; `/chain stop` drops only agent-kind mail with a `chain_stopped` tombstone receipt — user-kind mail is re-queued under a fresh id (the file layer dedupes re-sends against the consumed `read/` record — found by test) and always wakes.
- **Receipts (AC8)**: `chain_paused` events carry `reason: loop|budget` + evidence; legacy cap keeps `wake_refused` (UT + CLI REG).
- **Exemptions preserved (AC7)**: scheduled self-reminders stay exempt from every bound; timer semantics untouched; the rapid-self busy-spin guard stays armed whenever the legacy cap is on (with the cap off, the budget bounds spins instead — documented).
- **Config surface**: `messaging:` section (strict parse, both hosts read it — the app honors it through `AppFahSections`/`loadAppFahConfig`, same parsers, AC7 warn-and-default); parity registry classifies it as file-only with a WHY; completeness gate green.
- **Wake-gating only (AC9)**: delivery semantics, dedup, ordering untouched — a pause never consumes mail (REG tests assert pending stays pending across repeated ticks).
- Gates: standalone-SDK dart analyze clean on every touched file; dart format applied; targeted tests only — 221 core tests green (messaging 34 incl. 10 CLI wake REGs, parity completeness 14, attach 3); flutter analyze clean; app gh-1180 suite (4 tests incl. refusal receipts) green on the pinned 3.50.0 SDK; `agent_cli.dart` split (`agent_cli_chain_gate.dart` part) to stay under the 2800-line gate (2789).

## Remaining (honest scope vs the GOAL tiers)

- **App-side budget metering**: the Flutter host has no per-turn usage hook today, so its chain guard enforces loop verdicts but never accumulates spend — budget pauses on the app need the usage event surfaced first (CLI is the autonomous-chain workhorse; the guard-level UT covers the semantics).
- **App stop button**: the app offers resume-by-any-user-input (the GOAL's own no-deadlock advisory path) + the digest trail; a dedicated stop/continue affordance in the agents UI is not built (CLI has the full `/chain` surface).
- **Embedding-provider similarity**: implemented as the GOAL's documented fallback only (local shingle overlap, masked text) — there is no text-embedding provider in the repo to hook; adding one contradicts the issue's own 'no model calls in the wake path' non-goal.
- **Restart-persisted pause latching**: spend and stuck windows persist; the announce-once episode latch intentionally re-arms after restart so a still-held gate re-announces once (never silent).
- No prompt regeneration: the digest is user-facing UI chrome (same class as the existing `[mail] wake refused` line and btw panels); no agent-facing prompt text changed.

**ai-teammate** (2026-11-23):

🚨 severity: BLOCKING —
🚨 **BLOCKING: the boot-time chain-state restore can never arm — a restart always grants a fresh budget (breaks AC4)**

`_startChainStateRestore()` runs in the `AgentCli` constructor, but `_chainState` is assigned **only** by `_buildInboxWakePolicy()`, which is the initializer of `late final _inboxWakePolicy` (agent_cli.dart:2690) — evaluated lazily on **first access**. Nothing in the constructor (or wiring) touches `_inboxWakePolicy` before line 827; every production access is a later runtime event (typed input `agent_cli_input.dart:45`, steering delivery `agent_cli_inbox.dart:55/94`, the wake path `agent_cli_inbox.dart:396`, `/chain` `agent_hub_cli.dart:643`).

So at the moment this line executes, `_chainState` is always `null`, the method returns at its `if (chain == null) return;` guard, and `_chainStateRestored` stays the completed `Future.value()` it was initialized with. Consequences:

- `ChainStateStore.load()` is dead code in production — `tokensSpent` and the loop windows always start at zero on every boot, which is exactly the "restart grants a fresh budget mid-chain" outcome AC4 claims is impossible ("Spend + windows persist at `<messagesRoot>/_chain/state.json` … a restart never grants a fresh budget (snapshot round-trip UT)").
- Worse: the first `unawaited(_persistChainState())` after that boot **overwrites** `state.json` with a fresh-baseline snapshot, destroying the persisted record of prior spend — the state that a later fix would want to restore is gone.

The "snapshot round-trip UT" (`test/messaging/chain_loop_guard_test.dart:175`) exercises `snapshot()`→`restore()` in memory only — it never touches `ChainStateStore` or the boot wiring, and `chainSpendForTest` has zero test references, which is why this ships green.

Fix: make the construction eager at wiring — e.g. have `_startChainStateRestore()` call `_buildInboxWakePolicy()` itself (or touch `_inboxWakePolicy` before the restore call) — and pin it with a REG test that boots a CLI, books spend, restarts a second CLI on the same messages root, and asserts the spend survived (`chainSpendForTest` is already the seam for it).

---

**ai-teammate** (2026-11-23):

🚨 severity: BLOCKING —
🚨 **BLOCKING: with the cap off (the default), the scheduled-self busy-spin is unbounded — the documented budget bound does not exist (AC7)**

The doc block immediately above this line — and the PR's AC7 bullet ("the rapid-self busy-spin guard stays armed whenever the legacy cap is on (with the cap off, the budget bounds spins instead — documented)") — claims that with `wakeChatterCap: 0` a zero-delay re-schedule spin is bounded by the chain guard's budget. It is not, by construction:

1. **The guard is never consulted in this lane.** `ChainLoopGuard.evaluate()` is called only in the chatter lane (the last branch of `wakeDecisionFor`, line ~247). The scheduledSelf lane returns here (or as exempt) before any guard check — even a fully exhausted budget can never pause this lane.
2. **The spin never books spend either.** The CLI books usage only for chatter-lane runs (`approval_commands.dart:1164`: `if (_activeChainWakeLane == InboxWakeLane.chatter)`), and this wake's lane is `scheduledSelf`, so `tokensSpent` stays 0 during a pure spin.

Net behavior with defaults: a rapid (<30s cadence floor) scheduled-self spin increments `streak` forever but the streak is never checked (`maxStreak > 0` is false), so the spin **wakes forever with no bound at all** — the exact gh-1180 E5 busy-spin storm the cadence floor was built to bound, and a regression vs. pre-#2226 where the shared cap stopped it at 10.

Fix (either): consult the guard's budget in this rapid path when the cap is off (`chainGuard?.evaluate`-style budget check that can pause with a `budget` verdict), and/or book spend for spin-lane runs so the budget has data to act on. Then pin it with a test (a collapsed `scheduledSelfCadenceFloor` + `budgetTokens` guard must refuse), and keep the doc comment in sync with whatever ships.

---

**ai-teammate** (2026-11-23):

⚠️ severity: IMPORTANT —
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: `/chain stop` re-queue drops `fromName` and `hops` — and the drain→resend order loses user mail on a mid-command crash**

Two related problems in the preserve path:

1. **Fields dropped on the re-sent user mail.** The rebuilt `AgentMessage` copies `id` (fresh), `fromId`, `toId`, `text`, `kind`, `sentAt` — but omits:
   - `fromName` — on hub-relayed mail this names the HUMAN author ("the wire `fromId` is the relay's hub agent id — bare ids make agents greet relays instead of people", `agent_message.dart:43-47`). After a stop/keep cycle the preserved user input loses the author's name, reintroducing exactly the greet-the-relay problem the field exists to prevent.
   - `hops` — a relayed message's remaining relay budget silently resets to 0 (`refuses further relaying`), changing relay semantics for the preserved copy.

2. **Crash window loses user mail.** `fabric.drain(mailbox)` consumes pending into the `read/` records, then the user-kind copies are re-sent. If the process dies between the drain and the re-sends, the "user-kind mail always stays" guarantee (AC5) is broken permanently — the originals are consumed and the copies never existed. Sending the fresh-id copies **before** draining flips the failure mode to at-least-once duplicates (the fabric's own documented semantics) instead of data loss; the post-drain state is then identical for the normal path.

Suggested shape: read pending, re-send the user-kind copies first, then drain and tombstone the agent-kind leftovers. And copy `fromName:`/`hops:` verbatim onto the re-sent messages.

**ai-teammate** (2026-11-23):

💡 severity: SUGGESTION —
💡 **SUGGESTION: a bare `InboxWakePolicy()` is now completely unbounded — consider defaulting the chain guard on**

With `defaultMaxInboxWakeStreak = 0` and `chainGuard` nullable-defaulting to `null`, the SDK's default constructor produces a wake gate with **no bound at all** — the class doc states this explicitly ("Null keeps bare cap gating (and no bound at all when [maxStreak] is 0)"). ## Project layout — one line per subsystem

Full subsystem reference: `docs/agents/sdk-subsystems.md` (SDK) +
`docs/agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md` (app/packages/repo-level).

**SDK core (`lib/`, pure Dart):**

- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers, session modes, per-tool overrides, critical-bash interceptor, per-turn grants.
- `lib/src/tools/` — `ask`/`request_secret`/media tools, `read` selectors + archives + sqlite, background shell jobs, availability + load modes.
- `lib/src/env/` — `ExecutionEnv` impls: `LocalShell` (setsid, killTree, drain caps, self-signal immunity), session-correlation vars, in-memory default.
- `lib/src/agent/` — FinalizeGate, tool pairing, session image registry.
- `lib/src/trajectory/` — trajectory ledger core; goldens under `test/trajectory/goldens/`.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (prompt, tool args, output, logs).
- `lib/src/hashline/` — `[path#TAG]` patch language (SWAP/DEL/INS, stale-tag rejection).
- `lib/src/compaction/` — branch summarization + AutoCompactor → policy: `docs/compaction.md`.
- `lib/src/lsp/`, `lib/src/mcp/` — `lsp` + MCP protocol tooling (lazy servers, pure-Dart transports).
- `lib/src/model_roles/` — roles/fallbacks/keyring/watchdogs + provider catalog; `lib/src/ttsr/` — streaming-interrupt rules.
- `lib/src/skills/`, `lib/src/prompts/` — skills discovery; AGENTS/CLAUDE/GOAL/DESIGN auto-merge into the system prompt.
- `lib/src/task/`, `lib/src/messaging/`, `lib/src/session/attach/` — subagents, inbox fabric, attached sessions → `docs/subagents/README.md`.
- `lib/src/memory/` — long-term memory (hosted `flutter_agent_memory` package) → pitfalls: `docs/memory-churn.md`.
- `lib/src/a2a/` — Agent2Agent client/server/manager (`fa serve --a2a`).
- `bin/fah.dart` + `lib/src/cli/` — the `fa` CLI: REPL, slash commands, headless/serve modes → `docs/agents/cli.md`.
- `lib/src/cube/` — fa_cube sandbox profiles → `docs/cubes.md`; `lib/src/cli/hep.dart` — HEP event protocol → `docs/hep.md`.
- `lib/src/web_search/` — `web_search` (DDG keyless → keyed providers); `tool/fa-clip/` — native macOS pasteboard helper.

**packages/ + app shells:**

- `packages/fa_ui/` — reusable widgets (incl. trajectory) → `docs/agents/fa-ui.md`; `dap_hub`, `fa_llm`, `fa_llm_mock` → `docs/dap.md`.
- `flutter_app/` — the Flutter app (desktop/mobile/web) → `docs/agents/flutter-app.md`; services one-liner: `docs/agents/services.md`; JS apps: `docs/agents/js-apps.md`; HomeKit/Calendar/CodeMie: `docs/agents/system-integrations.md`.
- `browser_ext/` + `lib/src/browser/` + `bin/serve_bridge.dart` — browser extension + WebSocket bridge → `docs/browser-extension.md`.
- `office_addin/` + FA_HOST=office app host — Office add-in → `docs/outlook-addin.md`.
- `fa_network` — external Go backend bridged via the DAP hub (channel-id caveats: `docs/dap.md` §14).
- `site/`, `scripts/`, `docs/subagents/` — landing page (privacy sync), gates + codegen, subagents master plan → `docs/agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md`.

## Hard architecture rules (stay inline)

- `lib/` is pure Dart: **no `dart:io`** (must compile for web). The only
  `dart:io` entry points are `bin/` and `lib/io.dart`; file/process/network
  behind tools goes through the `ExecutionEnv` abstraction.
- Barrel `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart`: grouped **APPEND-ONLY** export
  sections — one `// ── <subsystem> ──` header per group, sorted by path
  within a group, new exports append to their group. No mini-barrels, no
  re-sorting (gh-1232).
- God-file ceiling: no `.dart` file over **2800** lines (crap4dart `loc`
  gate). Target < 2000 for primary files; split by concern into `part`
  files — never by extracting public API.

## Working in parallel (shared checkout + worktrees)

Do not modify files in this shared checkout unless the user asked; run no
heavy commands (full suites/analyze) in it; never `git stash` the user's
WIP; talk to peer agents through the messaging fabric, not their files.
Worktrees only if genuinely required — ask first, create detached under
`.worktrees/<name>/` from the remote tracking ref, remove when done.
Full policy: `docs/agents/parallel-worktrees.md`.

## Memory (footnote)

Before any non-trivial task, **search memory first** (`memory_search`,
then `memory_list` for fuzzy topics). Scopes: **project** = this repo
(`.fah/memory/note/` since gh-2185 — local-only, not committed; the
user's files: read freely, write only via `memory_add`), **user** = global/private. `memory_add` stores durable facts
only; supersede by delete + add — never leave solved problems to rot. The
host recomposes the `<memory>` prompt section after every add; tool wiring
is `memoryTools` + `lib/src/memory/`. Churn pitfalls: `docs/memory-churn.md`;
usage details: `docs/agents/memory-usage.md`.

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done: coverage first (`test/goldens/` + `golden_guard_test.dart`
map), real fonts (`ensureGoldenFonts`), full frames (1280x800 / 390x844),
determinism, eyes on pixels after `--update-goldens`, green
`flutter test test/goldens` + `scripts/check_goldens.py` (orphan snapshots
hard-fail). Full rules: `docs/agents/golden-tests.md`.

## Prompts live outside Dart code

Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (YAML frontmatter,
`{{token}}` placeholders) — never string literals in `.dart`. After
editing: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` regenerates the `.g.dart`
files (`test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart` gates drift); Codex catalog
refresh: `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Details:
`docs/agents/prompts.md`.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The hook is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI classifies
PRs through the same script (`--dry-run`) — one classifier, one threshold
set, hook/CI parity via `GATE_STAGE` markers. Path rules: docs/markdown/
prompts-only → size + analyze; lib/bin/test/pubspec → +tests, coverage,
CRAP, dup, dupx; `test/integration/**` → +integration-mock;
flutter_app/packages → +flutter; scripts/.github → everything. Invariants:

- analyze + format clean; `dart test` green — **deterministic-only**
  (mock LLM; live models never in the gate; `llm`-tagged files run only in
  the tag-only provider smoke + nightly).
- Line coverage of `lib/` ≥ 80%; jscpd < 1% core / < 3.7% app; cross-module
  dup < 0.31%; CRAP ratchet: core 12.0, app 30.0 (thresholds only-down);
  ≤ 2800 lines per `.dart` file; AGENTS.md ceiling (top of this file).
- Red-in-≥2-distinct-SHA-runs flakes quarantine via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json`; nightly keeps running quarantined files.

Full gate text: `docs/agents/quality-gates.md`; CI workflows: `docs/ci.md`.

## Cross-platform parity

Every shared setting and interactive prompt type exists on BOTH the CLI
and the Flutter app unless fundamentally impossible — then it MUST be in
`cliOnlySettings`/`appOnlySettings` (`lib/src/parity/settings_registry.dart`)
with the reason; run `dart test test/parity/`. Host capabilities (issue
#1079): every host-wiring capability declares its 7-host matrix state AT
BIRTH (`on` / `off(reason)` / `transport`) via `wireAgentCore` — `off` is
invisible everywhere; extensions are declared surface, SDK invariants have
no override point. Full rules: `docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md`.

## Commits and releases

- Commit as `ai.teammate <agent.ai.native@gmail.com>` (set repo-locally);
  subjects `type(scope): ...`. Release-path automation MUST use the
  fa-release-bot GitHub App token — never a PAT or `GITHUB_TOKEN`.
- Every push to main cuts an annotated tag (`scripts/auto_release.sh`);
  the tag is the single version source (pubspecs stay `0.0.0-dev`);
  releases go DRAFT-first and publish at `release-provenance` only with
  signed SHA256SUMS attached. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only (`## Unreleased`).
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag (first publish of a new
  package is manual); every lockfile is committed and enforced
  (`scripts/check_lockfiles.sh`); TestFlight external-group + store
  pipelines have required repo variables.

Full text: `docs/agents/commits-releases.md`.

## Bench

Bench knobs (agent timeouts, stall/watch, `FA_CONN_DEBUG`, hang replay,
report semantics) → `docs/bench.md` (round-3 knobs: issue #1392).

## Docs index

`docs/README.md` indexes every canonical doc (agents/, memory-churn,
compaction, dap, cubes, redaction, hep, ci, bench, browser-extension,
outlook-addin, …). New docs must be listed there.
